name: Nicola Maria Ferlaino
bioAdditions: Nicola Maria was baptized on 9 December 1778, son of Bruno Ferlaino and Francesca Moraca (S1). He married Agata Moraca, daughter of Michele, in 1801-02; the index lists the marriage on both 20 October 1801 and 12 June 1802 (S2). He died on 22 June 1835 and was buried the next day (S3, S4). His younger brother Vincenzo (b. 1781) was the father of Giuseppina Ferlaino (Carmine Fiorillo's wife). John's Ferlaino and Fiorillo lines therefore both descend from Bruno Ferlaino and Francesca Moraca.
funFacts: Pedigree collapse: Nicola (Leopoldo's grandfather) and his brother Vincenzo (Giuseppina Fiorillo's great-grandfather) were both sons of Bruno Ferlaino and Francesca Moraca, so Helen's parents were second cousins once removed.
